Approval of the minutes of the meetings held on March 09, 2023.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Angela Williams DBA City of Inglewood to host a Free Document Shredding and
  Possible E-Waste Donation Event between Grivellea and Manchester, Public
  Property, from Saturday, March 25, 2023, from 9:00 a.m.- 1:00 p.m; Saturday, June
  03, 2023, from 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. and Saturday, August 12, 2023, from 9:00 a.m.
  – 1:00 p.m. (Activity No.00362495)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Teresa Estrada DBA City of Inglewood to host an Easter Eggstravaganza Event at
  700 Warren Lane, Edward Vincent Jr. Park, Public Property, on Saturday, April 1,
  2023, from 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. (Activity No.00362532)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Jared Wilson DBA Wasserman to host a Target New Store Opening - Inglewood
  Event between N. Market at the intersection of E. Regent to E. Queen intersection,
  Public Property, on Sunday, April 2, 2023, from 12:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m. (Activity
  No.00362331)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial

Item #4:  Dyamond Daniel DBA Pieces Together Family Foundation to host an Autism -
  Acceptance Walk Event at 3400 W. Arbor Vitae St; Darby Park, Public Property, on

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial
